pull_request.title: Infrastructure: standardize detector component colors
pull_request.head: codex/detector-component-colors
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Define one fixed detector component palette on the main README using all nine human-specified hex values. New or regenerated component plots and illustrations must use those colors, including stacked histograms and their legends, with the same mapping across subsets and plotting orders.

## Change

- Add the canonical color table and plotting rules to `README.md`.
- Link the palette from mandatory contributor guidance in `AGENTS.md` and the TDR writing guide (`PUB-WRITING-2026-10-09`).
- Use labels, hatching, line styles or marker shapes for distinctions within a subsystem.
- Record this bounded infrastructure task in `SESSION-2026-11-03-component-colors` and its individual PR interaction ledger.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Infrastructure PR: no scientific progress entries added.
- [x] Exact check of all nine requested hex values, stacked-histogram rule and relative links passed.
- [x] `git diff --check` passed.
- [x] Session-log validation passed (226 records).
- [x] Token-dashboard build passed.
- [x] PR112 interaction record, canonical-account synchronization and base-revision retention validation passed.

Exact token counters for the active turn are unavailable and remain unknown in the session record. No detector design/ADR, geometry, existing figure evidence or layout changes are part of this style rule.

User request (paraphrase): put the beampipe, pixels, short strips, long strips,
ECAL, HCAL, FCAL, muons and magnet-system colors on the main README, and make a
rule requiring their use whenever those components are shown, including stacked
histograms. Prepare an infrastructure PR.

Exact supplied assignments: beampipe `#ffcc66`; pixels `#0066cc`; short strips
`#ff9933`; long strips `#009999`; ECAL `#cccc00`; HCAL `#663311`; FCAL `#99ccff`;
muons `#0066ff`; magnets `#999999`.
